name: Yitabo
description: Yitabo was a Mid Rim agriworld located in the Kastolar sector. Settled by Bornecks, Saurin, and Wookiees, it featured several settlements. Early in his career, the bounty hunter Cradossk tracked down and killed the thief Thoxo on Yitabo. The mercenary known as "Gunman" was later captured by Galactic Empire–affiliated slavers who were seizing Wookiees near Yitabo at some point by 8 ABY.
